name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 3 No 10

clue.text: Inexpensive year, including mater’s treatment by drugs, etc.
Item of sound-proofing equipment, eastern, needing a right hype
Lay around study, using few words
Called with nothing on in eastern capital
I observe in retirement one public school pupil
It’s a big sausage, master’s heard
Officer’s stand-in having to change name
Musically emotional harp Doc is playing
More than one stream entices, on going out
A neck of land is like this, covering a mile
See rushing water circle bishop in temporary home
Younger, and more environment-orientated?
It’s in Canada, not, oddly, a port in Brazil
Charge around the North —a stimulus, we hear, for a Royal
Person seeking a cause of death finds one in passage — not half
Work shelter erected, ’umble shack supplying fish
Various doings are co-ordinated
Fitted in satchel Velcro handle
Amaze and work hard, losing capital, to produce petroleum
Thoughtful writers I have

One in the company is among people being enrolled in list of saints
Assortment of tuck in kiosk? I’ll take the first bite, probably!

Crime-writer’s people love getting caught in wrongdoing
